title: DeepQuest: From Knowledge Gaps to Scientific Discovery in Alzheimer's Disease
abstract: arXiv:2611.26343v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automating experiments does not necessarily advance scientific understanding. Research agents must identify meaningful knowledge gaps, determine what available data can resolve, and assess whether their findings advance existing knowledge. We introduce DeepQuest, a knowledge-gap-driven AI scientist framework for Alzheimer's disease research. DeepQuest transforms unresolved questions from domain reviews into traceable, testable hypotheses and prioritizes them through data feasibility screening and groupwise Elo ranking. It couples iterative experimentation with two-level auditing that separates experimental reliability from knowledge contribution relative to two frozen literature corpora. On OASIS-3, DeepQuest produces 42 feasible hypotheses and outperforms the strongest baselines in 14 of 15 evaluator-dimension comparisons across three language-model reviewers. The full framework achieves an audit-assessed scientific finding rate of 95.2

translated_title: DeepQuest：从知识缺口到阿尔茨海默病的科学发现
translated_abstract: 自动化实验并不必然推进科学理解。研究智能体必须识别有意义的知识缺口，确定现有数据能够解决什么问题，并评估其发现是否推进了已有知识。我们提出DeepQuest，一个面向阿尔茨海默病研究的知识缺口驱动型AI科学家框架。DeepQuest将领域综述中未解决的问题转化为可追溯、可检验的假设，并通过数据可行性筛选和分组Elo排名对其进行优先级排序。该框架将迭代实验与两级审计相结合，将实验可靠性与相对于两个冻结文献语料库的知识贡献区分开来。在OASIS-3数据集上，DeepQuest产生了42个可行假设，并在三位语言模型评审员的15项评估维度比较中有14项优于最强基线。完整框架实现了95.2%的经审计评估的科学发现率。
tldr: DeepQuest是一个知识缺口驱动的AI科学家框架，它将阿尔茨海默病领域综述中的未决问题转化为可检验假设并自动开展迭代实验与两级审计，在OASIS-3上产生了42个可行假设，并以95.2%的审计评估科学发现率在绝大多数评估维度上超越最强基线。
en_tdlr: DeepQuest is a knowledge-gap-driven AI scientist framework that transforms unresolved questions from Alzheimer's disease reviews into traceable, testable hypotheses with iterative experimentation and two-level auditing, producing 42 feasible hypotheses on OASIS-3 and achieving a 95.2% audit-assessed scientific finding rate while outperforming the strongest baselines in 14 of 15 evaluator-dimension comparisons.
